releaseNotes: Welcome to Antarctic Kingdoms by Antarctic Gaming Co. Timeless games. A new world.
A new penguin royal-piece app icon, dark Antarctic lobby and fictional Frozen Archive discovery story.
Meet Polly, Retsba, Pengu and Abster; learn a first move in each game and track your local Archive journal.
Origin and edition notes distinguish living traditions, historical variants and modern adaptations.
All seven games, original artwork, legal moves, bots, private rooms and chat are retained.
Install over Arctic Play to keep your profile, favorites, saved seats and practice games. Old invitations still work.
